summary: Earth System Trend Detective is a simple, interactive platform created by team LUMORI to help everyone understand complex NASA climate and USGS earthquake data. Using NASA POWER historical records (1981-2025) and live seismic data, the platform shows important environmental changes in an easy way. Users can explore future temperature predictions powered by Al, compare two regions side-by-side on interactive globes, and generate quick scientific reports with one click. To make sure anyone around the world can use it, the platform supports 40 languages and adjusts its information for farmers, engineers, students, researchers, and everyday users. Our goal is to turn confusing space data into clear, helpful knowledge that keeps communities informed and safe.
details:
What does it do & How does it work?

Earth System Trend Detective is an interactive platform developed by team LUMORI that transforms complex NASA Earth observation and USGS seismic data into clear, actionable intelligence. It utilizes NASA POWER historical climate data (1981-2025) and integrates time-series Al forecasting to predict future temperature trends.

Key Features & Innovation:

• Role-Based Customization: Tailored insights for specific user groups including farmers, engineers, students, researchers, and the general public.

  • ﻿﻿Dual-Globe Comparison: Allows side-by-side regional analysis.
  • ﻿﻿Global Accessibility: Fully supports 40 languages and includes an automated Report Studio powered by Al for instant scientific report generation.

Tools & Technologies Used:

Developed using web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript), GitHub Pages for deployment, and integrated Al models for time-series forecasting and data analysis.
